title: Observation
description: A record of which artifact a build produced or a host ran, at one time. An observation with the source `running` is the only evidence that a fixed version runs; it closes an exposure.

source.description: `built`: a build produced the artifact. `running`: a host reported that the artifact runs.

artifact.description: The artifact: a Nix store path, an OCI image identifier, or the digest of a host package list.

deployment.description: Where the artifact runs, as `host/unit`. Absent for a build.

unit.description: The service unit on the host, or `os` for the host packages.

release.description: The release that the host ran when it reported.

state.description: The state of the unit that the host reported, for example `active` or `failed`.

loaded.description: The store paths that the process had mapped, when the host reported them.

components.description: The components of the artifact, when the observation carries them.
